title: The Gentle Whisper
reflectionQuestion: God did not come to Elijah in the loud and scary things, but in a soft little whisper. When everything is quiet, what do you think God might whisper to you?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Elijah whisper). The quintessential COMFORT/weary anchor -- counterweight to the louder stories in the batch. Elijah is tired/afraid/lonely; God feeds and rests him (the angel + bread, one gentle beat) and then comes not in wind/quake/fire but in a gentle whisper. The loud things are kept brief and not scary; the whole story lands on the quiet whisper. mood=weary (the lane's main weary anchor); the kid mood bridge routes a worn-out / overwhelmed child here. Indelible image = the gentle whisper / Elijah's coat over his face. 'You are loved... not alone' = the not-alone spine, said softly (feedback_kid_not_alone_thread). NO Yahweh -- this is the whisper, the NAME is not the point; save covenant-name Yahweh for Carmel later (Adam). VOICE_NOAH_PATIENT (steady, calm) -- fits the contemplative whisper; re-voiced 2026-06-22 from the now-banned ELIJAH_SAGE.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
